system.description: You were fortunate enough to receive a blooding by the Code of Samiel performed properly, and so may learn the abilities granted by this blooding if you can find a teacher. You must have an excellent reason for possessing this Merit, and your good fortune may arouse suspicion both in and out of clan. Only warrior Salubri may take this Merit.
system.source: Clanbook: Salubri (Dark Ages), Chapter Four: The Powers of the Righteous
